date: undated; nomenclator of the Romagna war of 1424-1425
title: Medici key with a Romagna nomenclator (Agnolo della Pergola, Piccinino, Faenza, Forlì, Oriolo ...): possible key for the Faenza 1425 letter
correspondents: unattributed ("Cifra"); Florentine commissioners in the Romagna (Averardo de' Medici?)
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Mediceo avanti il Principato, filza LXXII, doc. 180 (old c. 212)
folio_note: One leaf: alphabet with two homophones per letter, signs for da, se, si, et, non, con, per, che, quando, dove, come, del; nomenclator of Visconti and papal captains (Agnolo della Pergola, Secco da Montagnana, Niccolò Guerrieri, Opicino d'Alzate, Cristoforo da Lavello, Taliano, Fornaino, messer Pandolfo [Malatesta], Niccolò Piccinino, Niccolò da Tolentino ...) and places (Castrocaro, Oriolo, Forlì, Imola, Faenza, Cesena, Bologna) plus fanti a piè, gente d'arme, cavalli. Inventory vol. 3: "« Cifra », n. 180".
status: Key only, no ciphertext on the sheet. Agnolo della Pergola died in 1428; the names fit the Florentine-Milanese war in the Romagna of 1424-25, when Averardo de' Medici was commissioner at Faenza.
why: The first candidate key for catalogue 337 / targets/medici1425 (Averardo de' Medici and Piero Guicciardini, Faenza, 27 Oct 1425, cipher part unread; NOTES say "No key known"). Also a dated pre-1430 Florentine key for the Dieci commissioner family (florence1429).
verify: Transcribe the table; compare with the Ricasoli 1424 key (targets/florence1429/key_extended.md); apply to the 1425 Faenza letter when its images are obtained; check MAP I nos. 89-207 (Averardo's Faenza file) for letters in this cipher.

date: undated; nomenclator of the Lucca war of 1429-1433
title: "Cifra d'Averardo con Astore": key of Averardo de' Medici with Astorre (Gianni), Lucca war
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Mediceo avanti il Principato, filza LXXII, doc. 182 (old c. 214)
folio_note: One leaf: one-sign-per-letter alphabet; nomenclator: Dieci, fanti a piè, gente d'arme, Berardino [della Carda], Ridolfo, cavalli, Signore di Lucca, messer Ranaldo figliuolo del Signore di Lucca, Baldaccio d'Anghiari, Duca di Milano, Niccolò Piccinino, Genova, Tommaso da Campofregoso, Bartolomeo Orlandini, Rinaldo degli Albizzi, Cosimo, Pietrasanta, Motrone, Castiglione di Garfagnana, Camaiore, Nozzano, Montecarlo, Lucca, amico, nimico, Signori, Averardo, Astore ... Endorsed "Cifra d'Averardo con Astore". Inventory vol. 3: n. 182.
status: Key only, no ciphertext. The Lucca names date it c. 1430 (Averardo and Astorre Gianni were commissioners in the Lucca war).
why: An Averardo de' Medici key five years after the Faenza letter (catalogue 337): a second candidate family for it, and the key for any Averardo/Astorre letter of 1430 in the Dieci Responsive or MAP.
verify: Transcribe; test with lead 180 on the Faenza 1425 letter; look for Lucca-war cipher letters in MAP and Dieci Responsive 1430.

title: Medici key sheets, MAP filza LXXII nos. 178-179, 181, 183-188 (Alamanni, ser Andrea da Bologna, Baccio Ugolini, Soderini, Biliotti, Cambini, "Diverse cifre")
correspondents: Lorenzo de' Medici's chancery <-> Piero Alamanni (178), ser Andrea da Bologna (179), Baccio Ugolini (181), Paolantonio Soderini (183), Agostino Biliotti and Lionetto (184), Andrea Cambini (185); 186 'Cifra indiavolata'; 187 trial sheet; 188 'Diverse cifre'
shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Mediceo avanti il Principato, filza LXXII, docs. 178, 179, 181, 183-188 (old cc. 210-229)
folio_note: 178: small alphabet with homophones and doubles (endorsed "Alamanni Piero"); 179: alphabet a-g = 1-9, h-y = Greek letters, doubles, nomenclator (Papa, Reformando, Duca, Lorenzo, Sforza, Iacopo Pitti?, Firenze, popolo, Riformatori ...); 181: nomenclator (Re Ferrando, Duca di Calabria, ... Piero di Lorenzo, Giuliano di Lorenzo); 183: alphabet with 3 homophones, nulls, numbered nomenclator (Papa, Re di Napoli, Veneziani, Duca d'Urbino ... Napoli, Siena, Arezzo); 184-185: alphabets, doubles, "Nihil importantes", nomenclators (Duca di Ferrara, Bentivoglio, Gianfigliazzi, Sanseverino ...); 186 (cc. 218-219): alphabet with 4-5 homophones; 187: scribbled trial sheet with a few cipher lines; 188 (cc. 222-229): alphabet, doubles, nulls and a long code list.
status: Keys only (187 has a few trial lines, no letter). None checked against the bare MAP leads yet.
why: The keys to try first on MAP leads 2309 (XLVIII 214), 2310 (LXXII 213-214: its digits-plus-Greek signs recall key 179), 2311 (LXXIII 371), the LXXII 211/216 rows and any Laurentian cipher letter in MAP.
verify: Transcribe each key; match sign inventories against the bare MAP letters; record matches.
